svg.title: Copenhagen meet Green SM — final poster v07
svg.desc: A0 landscape marketing-plan poster, final version v07 (D-166): proposed DKK30M gated market-entry plan, four segments with 25–44 as focus, campaign Copenhagen, meet Green SM with Go Green / For a Green Future. Figures come from scale-plan model v02. Lettering reuses the approved glyph outlines.
